title: ticfac skills diff (or a doctor line): say when an installed skill copy is older than the binary
description: Nothing tells an operator that the ticfac skill installed in a repo (.claude/skills/ticfac, .agents/skills/ticfac — stamped with the version that installed it) is older than the binary. tk has tk skills diff for the ticks skill; add the same for ticfac (and/or a ticfac doctor line) naming the upgrade command, ticfac skills install ticfac.
acceptance_criteria: installed copy older than the binary is reported with the upgrade command; test; make gate
